title: Price promotion break-even before discounting
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: Whether a discount can pay for itself: the sales lift needed is discount / (margin - discount).
applies_when: Owner proposes a discount or sale
exclusions: Discount at or above margin (always loses)
evidence_requirements: expected volume lift (own history or a range)
share of promo buyers who bought before
missing_data_behavior: No margin: refuse the calculation and ask for it.
implementation_steps: Compare with expected lift; if unknown use elasticity -2.5 as a labelled central guess
Subtract a post-promo dip if stockpiling is possible
Prefer shallow cuts and feature/visibility support over depth
dependencies: owner confirms margin; ClimbOS never invents an offer

cash_and_labor_requirements.capability: sales by day and by customer
cash_and_labor_requirements.measurement: baseline vs promo period; share of promo buyers who are new

metrics: share of promo buyers new to the brand
guardrails: No discount in a first lifecycle touch (agrees with skills/retention-lifecycle)
alternatives_when_constrained: No margin data: block the promotion recommendation until the owner gives it
No history: run one shallow, short test with a clear baseline window
stop_conditions: Stop repeating a promo whose incremental contribution was negative
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Ignoring baseline sales sold at a discount
Counting promo volume as new customers

economic_feasibility.rule: proposed rule: add promoBreakEven(margin, discount) to shared/analysis/decisions.ts returning required lift = d/(m-d) and blocking promos where d >= m

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed rule: a promotion play may not claim new-customer acquisition for an established brand without new-buyer data
proposed rule: elasticity -2.5 is only a labelled fallback, never a forecast

missing_prerequisite.rule: proposed rule: no promotion recommendation without owner-confirmed margin

reconciliation_note: Book table 10.2 has an arithmetic error at 40% margin and 5% discount (14.3%, not 10%).
